title: Var Mısın?
author: Beyza Özaydın
description:
When Ada wakes after a night of drinking, she is rushed into meeting the family of the man she was supposed to marry. But the man sitting beside his parents isn’t her boyfriend, Koray. It’s Poyraz, a stranger she vaguely remembers throwing a drink at the night before. And he has a marriage certificate to prove they’re already married.

Ada wants the accidental marriage annulled, until Poyraz reveals that their exes have betrayed them both. He proposes a deal: stay married, convince their families it’s real, and use their unlikely alliance to get revenge. Ada agrees, though she can barely remember how they ended up married in the first place. As they put their plan into motion, what else might this impulsive decision bring into their lives? Does Ada dare to say yes?
